description: This file defines a custom exception class 'InteropKycDataNotFoundException' that extends a platform-specific base exception. It is used to indicate that KYC data for a specific client ID was not found, within the context of interoperation features in the project.

classes.name: InteropKycDataNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that KYC data was not found for a given client ID.

methods.name: InteropKycDataNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an error message for the specified client ID and optional underlying cause.
